title: Sector Flows Flash Update: Markets internals shift back to "Tightening financial conditions" fears as "Goldilocks" hopes fade

classification.rationale: The note is a US equity sector flows and regime-clustering update with a relative-value sector backtest, which is an equity strategy topic that fits none of the rates/FX/macro/central bank categories as its main purpose.
classification.runner_up_reason: It discusses tightening financial conditions, Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech and Middle East escalation as drivers, but the focus is equity sector positioning, not a macro risk scenario.
